mace.status: First appearance of the flanged-head form
mace.description: Royal Collection Trust dates the appearance of this European flanged-head form to the fourteenth century, noting that it remained rare before the fifteenth. This concerns the head form rather than the much older history of maces generally.
mace.evidence: Royal Collection Trust’s institutional publication says the flanged head first appeared in the fourteenth century. The record’s own parade mace is dated 1400–1500, which is not used as the first-appearance date.
